Mint Mobile Announces New Promotional Pricing for Google Pixel 11 Series

27 Oct 2026, 11:22 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Tech Desk · Source: www.techradar.com

Overview of the Promotion

Mint Mobile has introduced a revised promotional offer for the Google Pixel 11 series, providing consumers with new opportunities to acquire the devices at a reduced cost. The current offer includes a $500 discount on the upfront price of any Google Pixel 11 model when activating a new line of service. This represents an increase of $50 over previous promotional pricing offered by the carrier.

Plan and Trade-in Details

In addition to the device discount, the carrier is offering a promotion on its service plan. Customers can purchase a full year of unlimited data for $180, which equates to $15 per month. This price represents a 50% discount on the standard annual rate for this data tier. Furthermore, users have the option to trade in an existing device to receive an additional rebate of up to $400. The total value of the deal is contingent upon the specific device traded in and the chosen Pixel 11 model.

What Consumers Should Know

The offer is currently available for the entire Google Pixel 11 range, including standard and Pro-level models. Because the Pixel 11 is a relatively new release, these promotions are designed to incentivize new customers to join the prepaid network.

Uncertainties and Verification

While the promotional terms are clearly defined, potential customers should be aware that trade-in values vary based on the model and condition of the device being submitted. Consumers are encouraged to verify the specific terms of the trade-in program, as well as the eligibility requirements for the new line activation, directly on the carrier's official website. As with any retail promotion, users may want to weigh the benefits of current offers against potential future holiday-season discounts, though the carrier has not made public announcements regarding further price adjustments for the remainder of the year. Interested parties can review the offer details and terms on the official website: https://www.techradar.com/phones/google-pixel-phones/the-google-pixel-11-has-hit-a-new-record-low-at-mint-mobile-get-up-to-usd900-off-plus-a-cheap-plan.
